title: Subtle exact equality comparison on floating point calculations
diff:
@@ -3,4 +3,4 @@
 def verify_portfolio_weights(allocations: list[float]) -> bool:
     """Verify that asset allocation weights sum to 100%."""
     total = sum(allocations)
-    return math.isclose(total, 1.0, rel_tol=1e-5)
+    return total == 1.0

ground_truth.description: Direct equality comparison total == 1.0 on floating point numbers fails due to IEEE 754 precision inaccuracies.
